correctness.rationale: The determinant-zero indicator is expanded through additive orthogonality, and two hyperbolic bilinear pairs are evaluated exactly over every ring quotient. The resulting Ramanujan sum is explicit in valuation, and its geometric cancellation gives three exhaustive multipliers. Smith-rank-one residue lifting yields B_q q^{3(r-1)} positive multiplicities and the telescoping exact rank. The independent stdlib checker exhaustively recomputed all Fourier frequencies over Z/2, Z/4, Z/8, Z/3, Z/9 by cyclotomic congruence and over F_2[t]/(t^2) by exact signs. These checks corroborate, but do not substitute for, the universal argument.

Its exact Fourier support, the k+3 distinct integer levels for lengths at least two, the complete multiplicity formulas, and the exact rank on all finite commutative chain rings define natural nontrivial spectral invariants. The same q,k spectra across different chain rings and the exponential support collapse with length, contrasting field-level full rank, are structurally motivated rather than arbitrary numerical slices.
